Every Street Stops

HS Engineering Design · Talk Show Panel · African Diaspora Voices · Deck A · SSF-HS11-L1-1400P-HSSCIENG1112-TSP-AAD
THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

You are on the school talk show today. The show is about the street in front of the school. You must say how long the walk light should stay on. You need four numbers, and four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

Today's show is about Garrett Morgan, a Black inventor. In 1923 he made a new kind of traffic light. It could stop the cars on every street at the same time. That gave people time to cross safely.
